payload.title: File:Parastylephorus anatoides (skeletal reconstruction).png
payload.artist_html: L. Ridolfi, A. E. Schrøder, A. Bahrami, M. Yazdi, A. Roa-Varón, G. Marramà, G. Carnevale
payload.credit_html: "A new fossil from the Eocene of Iran provides new insights regarding the evolution of the morphologically bizarre tube-eye fish"
payload.description_html: Interpretive reconstruction of the skeleton of Parastylephorus anatoides from the Eocene of Babaheydar, Iran. The anal and caudal fins (light grey shading) are reconstructed based on Stylephorus chordatus.
